name: LEDA 1313424 (Hubble)
blurb: LEDA 1313424, the Bullseye ring galaxy, seen by Hubble.
label: leda1313424-hubble
story: The Bullseye: a gargantuan galaxy rippling with rings of stars, set in motion when a far smaller dwarf galaxy shot straight through its heart. Astronomers count nine rings in all, eight of them spotted by Hubble.

claims.text: LEDA 1313424 is a gargantuan galaxy rippling with star-filled rings
The rings formed after a far smaller dwarf galaxy shot through its heart
It has nine rings; Hubble identified eight and Keck confirmed a ninth
It is a collisional ring galaxy
